criteria_results.text: With no Engraph executable, Rhythm remains fully functional on FTS; setup/status reports a clear install path without requiring shell or environment-variable edits.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract; not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: Discovery checks `PATH` and supported common Homebrew locations; a binary picker can choose another executable and persists only a validated path.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract; not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: Rhythm creates and uses only its Application Support HOME/index; `~/.engraph` remains untouched in verified tests/manual inspection.
criteria_results.notes: Real Engraph live test used only the isolated sandbox Application Support HOME and returned to fail-safe retrieval after disable.

criteria_results.text: Only the canonical agent-memory directory is indexable; arbitrary, traversal, symlink-escape, and whole-vault paths are rejected or safely normalized to the approved root.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract; not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: Setup/indexing is asynchronous and does not block app startup or normal requests.
criteria_results.notes: The signed client stayed responsive while the real sandbox lifecycle advanced to Ready.

criteria_results.text: Managed service access is loopback-only, authenticated, and read-only; external/non-loopback and unauthenticated access fail.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract; not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: The health state requires a real authenticated search to complete within one second. Process existence or an open port alone is insufficient.
criteria_results.notes: The env-gated HTTP test reached Ready only after the real authenticated search assertion passed.

criteria_results.text: Disabled, missing, unhealthy, timeout, malformed-result, or permission-blocked Engraph always falls back safely to FTS without breaking prompt construction.
criteria_results.notes: The signed permission-denied state remained usable and explicitly reassured that standard memory search was active.

criteria_results.text: Start, shutdown, retry, and rebuild affect only the exact process Rhythm owns; no unrelated process can be terminated.
criteria_results.notes: Unrelated PID 37322 survived real start, retry, rebuild, health, and disable actions.

criteria_results.text: Stored settings, logs, API responses, and UI-safe diagnostics contain no secrets, indexed memory content, user query text, or unnecessary sensitive path details.
criteria_results.notes: The signed client exposed fixed category guidance only; no backend failure detail or indexed content rendered.

criteria_results.text: Signed-app behavior accounts for expected Gatekeeper/TCC/notarization/signing failures without bypassing macOS protections.
criteria_results.notes: Apple Development-signed app rendered sandbox-only permission_denied as Privacy & Security guidance plus an explicit instruction not to bypass macOS protection, then recovered through Enable to Ready.

criteria_results.text: Settings presents Semantic Memory as optional, local, and fail-safe; staff can understand the status without developer knowledge.
criteria_results.notes: The signed UI rendered the optional/private/fail-safe description and plain-language Off, Needs attention, and Ready states.

criteria_results.text: Users can enable/disable semantic memory, request a health check/retry, open install guidance, select a binary, and request a confirmed rebuild through supported backend APIs.
criteria_results.notes: Signed-client Enable and Disable actions were exercised against the real isolated backend; the full action set was visible.

criteria_results.text: The UI renders each required state/copy above from backend state and stays responsive during validation/indexing/rebuild.
criteria_results.notes: Backend-injected permission state and real lifecycle Ready/Off states rendered without a client stall.

criteria_results.text: No UI flow asks the user to edit environment variables, shell configuration, ports, tokens, or `~/.engraph`.
criteria_results.notes: The signed UI exposed only supported buttons and plain-language setup guidance.

criteria_results.text: The binary picker follows existing app conventions and only submits the selected path to backend validation; the client does not trust it as healthy.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract; not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: Failure views are sanitized, actionable, accessible, and explicitly reassure users that standard memory search remains active.
criteria_results.notes: The signed accessibility tree contained the sanitized actionable sentence and standard-search reassurance.

criteria_results.text: macOS permission/security failures have clear, safe guidance and do not suggest bypassing system protection.
criteria_results.notes: The signed accessibility tree contained 'Do not bypass macOS protection.'

criteria_results.text: Rebuild copy and behavior make clear that only Rhythm’s Application Support index is affected.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the automated contract and real HTTP rebuild; confirmation dialog was not repeated manually.

criteria_results.text: UI never displays indexed content, queries, auth data, secrets, or unnecessary sensitive paths.
criteria_results.notes: The signed Settings surface displayed only fixed status copy and Engraph version.
